sources.document_title: STUSB4500 standalone USB PD sink controller with short-to-VBUS protections
sources.locator: Section 2, Table 1, QFN pin-function rows; Sections 2.2.1 through 2.2.16
sources.evidence_extract: Current manufacturer-authored DS12499 Rev 8 retained from a reproducible mirror. QFN pins 1..24 and EP are enumerated. CC is Hi-Z in reset; CCDB enables passive dead-battery Rd. DISCH and VBUS_VS_DISCH have distinct sense/discharge roles. VBUS_EN_SNK is active-low open drain; mirror authority cannot close PRIMARY-SPEC trust.

sources.document_title: STUSB4500 standalone USB PD sink controller with short-to-VBUS protections
sources.locator: Section 7.1, Table 20, absolute maximum rating rows VDD, CC/CCDB and high-voltage VBUS pins
sources.evidence_extract: Rev 8 Table 20 states VDD absolute maximum 28 V, CC1/CC2/CC1DB/CC2DB high-voltage absolute maximum 22 V, and VBUS_EN_SNK/VBUS_VS_DISCH/DISCH/POWER_OK2 high-voltage absolute maximum 28 V. Mirror authority cannot close primary-only trust.

sources.locator: Sections 3.22 through 3.25, register tables 0x25 through 0x29; Sections 3.60 through 3.72
sources.evidence_extract: NVM initializes startup registers. Discharge timing defaults are 800 ms to 0 V and 270 ms between contracts; forced discharge control is separate. PDO registers are volatile R/W views initialized by NVM.

sources.locator: nets rows VBUS_IN, CC1, CC2, CC1DB, CC2DB, VBUS_VS_DISCH, VBEN, Net-(Q1-G), VBUS_OUT, Net-(U1-DISCH), VREG_2V7, SCL-pin1, SDA-pin2, ATT, PDOK and GND
sources.evidence_extract: Committed scripts/schgen/baselines/board-a.json, derived from the board-a net-connectivity doc table (fixed circuit after the locked #90 fix list). U1.24 sits on VBUS_IN with C1/C2, R14.1, R11.2, Q1.2, J3.4 and D5.1. U1.18 reaches VBUS_IN only through R14 (TP6 on the node). U1.9 reaches VBUS_OUT only through R13. U1.16 (VBEN) drives Q1.1 through R12 with R11 pull-up to VBUS_IN and C35 to GND. R19/R20 bridge CC1DB/CC2DB to CC1/CC2; R17.1/R18.1 land on CC1/CC2 with R17.2/R18.2 on GND (DNP placements). U1.11 (ATT) lands on J3.6 and J4.3; U1.20 (PDOK) on J3.7 and J4.4. U1.23 (VREG_2V7) bridges to C30.2, R15.2, R16.2 and J3.3. U1.6, U1.10, U1.12, U1.13, U1.22 and U1.25 are on GND.
